run.summary_md:
## What changed
Revenue moved from $129.7B to $153.3B — +18.2% ($23.6B) from 2025-Q2 to 2026-Q2.

## Why
- **Cloud** (47% of the move, $11.1B): Cloud +81.8% ($11.1B, volume-led)
- **Search Ads** (40% of the move, $9.5B): Search Ads +16.8% ($9.5B, volume-led)

## What's driving it
- Cloud: volume $9.6B of $11.1B
- Cloud: top 3 accounts = 40% of the segment move
- Search Ads: volume $7.4B of $9.5B
- Search Ads: paid_clicks +13.0% × cpc +3.0% ≈ +16.4% (reported +16.8%)
- Search Ads: top 3 accounts = 16% of the segment move

## Context from previous runs
- Search Ads normally grows +12% ± 2pp (4 periods)
- Search Ads shows a Q4 seasonal lift (~+12pp)
- Cloud normally grows +24% ± 13pp (4 periods)
- Cloud growth has exceeded 20% for 2 consecutive periods

## Watch-outs
- CapEx +87.8% to $15.4B; free cash flow $34.8B (-2.8%) despite the operating move
- Cloud moved 4.8σ outside its trailing band — verify durability before annualizing
- Enterprise growth rides on 3 accounts (64% of the move) — retention risk
- Enterprise moved 4.1σ outside its trailing band — verify durability before annualizing

## What changed
Revenue moved from $129.7B to $153.3B — +18.2% ($23.6B) from 2025-Q2 to 2026-Q2.

## Why
- **Cloud** (47% of the move, $11.1B): Cloud +81.8% ($11.1B, volume-led)
- **Search Ads** (40% of the move, $9.5B): Search Ads +16.8% ($9.5B, volume-led)

## What's driving it
- Cloud: volume $9.6B of $11.1B
- Cloud: top 3 accounts = 40% of the segment move
- Search Ads: volume $7.4B of $9.5B
- Search Ads: paid_clicks +13.0% × cpc +3.0% ≈ +16.4% (reported +16.8%)
- Search Ads: top 3 accounts = 16% of the segment move

## Context from previous runs
- Search Ads normally grows +12% ± 2pp (4 periods)
- Search Ads shows a Q4 seasonal lift (~+12pp)
- Cloud normally grows +24% ± 13pp (4 periods)
- Cloud growth has exceeded 20% for 2 consecutive periods

## Watch-outs
- CapEx +87.8% to $15.4B; free cash flow $34.8B (-2.8%) despite the operating move
- Cloud moved 4.8σ outside its trailing band — verify durability before annualizing
- Enterprise growth rides on 3 accounts (64% of the move) — retention risk
- Enterprise moved 4.1σ outside its trailing band — verify durability before annualizing
